newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent steady, NYMEX maintains firm tone.
newsitem.headline: Brent steady, NYMEX maintains firm tone.

text.p: September Brent crude futures were untraded at midday on Thursday but were marked steady in line with London's overnight settlement.
September Brent was quoted on SIMEX at $18.35/$18.45 per barrel, after London 17 cents to settle at $18.39.

NYMEX crudes maintained their firm tone on ACCESS in the wake of supportive data from the U.S. Department of Environment showing a decline in gasoline stocks, reinforcing a similar decline seen in the day-earlier API data.
On ACCESS, September crude futures were last traded at $19.67 per barrel, adding four cents to the 15 cents gained in New York overnight.
The DoE said gasoline stocks in the U.S. fell 2.3 million barrels. The API had reported a 2.8 million barrel fall.
